nodes.name: Gmail Trigger - Project Inquiry
nodes.notes: Polls every minute for emails labeled Project-Inquiry that are not Lead-Processed. Simplify=false so full body text is available for AI.

nodes.name: Idempotency + Prepare Email
nodes.notes: Skips already-processed message IDs via workflow static data and normalizes subject/from/body.

values.content:
You are an expert lead qualification assistant for a senior AI Engineer specializing in: ML, LLM Applications, AI Agents, RAG Systems, Automation (n8n/Zapier/Make), and Full-Stack Development.

Analyze inbound project-inquiry emails and return ONLY valid JSON (no markdown fences, no commentary) with exactly these keys:
{
  "projectType": "string — e.g. AI Agent, Automation, RAG System, Web App, Other",
  "budgetRange": "string — e.g. $1000-$3000, Unknown if not stated",
  "timeline": "string — e.g. 1 month, Unknown if not stated",
  "keyRequirements": "string — concise summary of requirements",
  "fitScore": 1,
  "leadQuality": "High"
}

Scoring rules for fitScore (integer 1-10):
- 9-10: Clear AI/LLM/Agent/RAG/automation project with budget and timeline
- 7-8: Strong AI/automation fit; some details missing
- 4-6: Partial fit or vague inquiry
- 1-3: Poor fit (unrelated, spam, non-technical)

leadQuality mapping:
- High if fitScore >= 7
- Medium if fitScore is 4, 5, or 6
- Low if fitScore <= 3

If budget/timeline are missing, use "Unknown". Always fill every field.

nodes.name: OpenAI - Qualify Lead
nodes.notes: gpt-4o-mini with JSON output. On failure, error branch logs and continues so labels are still updated.

nodes.name: Log AI Failure
nodes.notes: Fallback path when OpenAI fails: still writes a sheet row and creates a holding draft.

nodes.name: Append to Google Sheets
nodes.notes: Replace YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID. Tab name must be Leads with exact headers from SETUP.md.

conditions.leftValue: ={{ Number($('Parse AI JSON').isExecuted ? $('Parse AI JSON').item.json.fitScore : $('Log AI Failure').item.json.fitScore) }}

parameters.subject: =Re: {{ $('Parse AI JSON').item.json.subject }}

nodes.name: Gmail Draft - High Fit
nodes.notes: Creates an interested draft reply. Review and send manually in Gmail.

parameters.subject: =Re: {{ $('Parse AI JSON').isExecuted ? $('Parse AI JSON').item.json.subject : $('Log AI Failure').item.json.subject }}
parameters.message:
=Hi,

Thank you for your message and for considering me for this work.

I've received your inquiry and will review it carefully. At the moment my availability is focused on AI/LLM, agents, RAG, and automation projects, so I may need a little time to confirm fit and capacity.

I'll follow up shortly with either next steps or a referral if another specialist would be a better match.

Appreciate your patience.

Best regards
